history.summary: A freehold 1,044 sqft 3BR (The Ramford, D15 East Coast, 2022) at $2.188M / $2,096 psf — a steep ~14% premium to the $1,837 URA median on a near-meaningless 6-transaction base showing a slightly negative resale rate. A boutique freehold paying well above area value with no liquidity to support exit.
history.rating_rationale: $2,096 psf is ~14% above the $1,837 URA median — a large premium, not a discount — and the only project data is 6 transactions with a -0.3% resale rate, i.e. no reliable appreciation signal and essentially no liquidity. The low score (458) and off-frontier status confirm it is overpriced. D15 freehold and the new 2022 build are positives, but 1.27km to Marine Parade TE26 and a boutique block paying a 14% premium with a 6-txn history is a poor 5-7yr investment — clear Avoid.
red_flags: ~14% above URA median ($2,096 vs $1,837) — large overpayment
Only 6 URA txns and a -0.3% resale rate — no liquidity or upside signal
catalysts: Freehold D15 East Coast lifestyle district with deep owner-occupier base
New 2022 build — low maintenance, modern fittings
Marine Parade TEL station (TE26) opened, improving connectivity over time
